items.title: Michael Sanft, lawyer for man convicted of Tupac Shakur’s murder, dies at 55
items.brief: Michael Sanft, the lawyer who defended Duane “Keffe D” Davis in the Tupac Shakur murder trial in August, has died, according to the coroner’s office in Clark County, Nevada.

items.title: Steel plant blast kills 16 in western Turkey
items.brief: A blast at a steel and iron manufacturing plant in western Turkey on Monday killed 16 people, President Recep Tayyip Erdogan said after a cabinet meeting.

items.title: Pope Leo urges President Milei, a Trump ally, to ‘safeguard democracy’ on arrival in Argentina
items.brief: Pope Leo XIV has called on Argentine President Javier Milei and the country’s political leaders to “safeguard democracy” and demonstrate a “careful use of words” during his first speech in Buenos Aires.

items.title: A Brooklyn jogger’s father found her bleeding on a dark path. A teacher’s aide is now charged with killing her
items.brief: A teacher’s aide who briefly worked as a New York City police officer has been charged with murder in connection with the fatal stabbing of a jogger, according to court documents.
